reserveReview.rationale: The issuer-run Mento reserve API capture on 2026-09-04 reports the CADm composition normalized into nine categories: AUSD 25.2526269974%, sUSDS 23.6006620382%, CELO 19.9962210845%, USDT family 11.1748029639%, EUROP 5.8444344408%, EURC family 5.7141944912%, USDC family 4.2360109295%, stETH 3.1193313335%, and ETH/WETH 1.0617157210%. Every positive category is retained; tracked stablecoin exposures are linked and CELO, stETH, and ETH/WETH remain explicit exogenous collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-run Mento Reserve API capture normalized by stablecoin family and exogenous asset; CADm is represented by the shared Mento reserve composition
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every positive shared-reserve API row is retained in the nine normalized stablecoin-family or exogenous-asset slices, and CELO, stETH, and ETH/WETH remain explicitly exogenous collateral.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

ETH/WETH is external cryptoasset collateral (the API's native ETH row on Ethereum plus its residual Celo WETH row, combined into one 'ETH/WETH' slice by the Pharos Mento adapter), not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
